how_to_edit: Active items: one slot, used with Space (the special button). Isaac-style.
charge: "rooms" refills one pip per room you clear (rooms = how many pips); "timer" refills over seconds.
Picking one up gives it fully charged. Picking up another swaps: the old one is left on the pedestal.
classes: which adventurers can find it. An empty list means every class.
icon: attack, defense, move, mode, special, spell, gold, potion (the relic icon set).
effect: the numbers for what it does; see scripts/slasher/slasher_active_effects.gd for each kind.
treasure_chance: how often a treasure room holds an active item instead of a relic. The first treasure room of a run always does while your slot is empty.
Authored pixel art is loaded by item id from res://assets/slasher/active_item_icons/<id>.png; legacy items use procedural glyphs.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Dash a short way in the direction you're moving, untouchable while you do.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Spin with your blade out, hitting everything around you three times as hard and throwing it back.

earthsplitter.name: Earthsplitter
earthsplitter.description: Slam your sword down: a crack tears along the ground ahead, hurting and stunning everything in its path.

war_horn.name: War Horn
war_horn.description: A battle cry: for 6 seconds you hit 50% harder and swing 40% faster, and nearby foes are knocked back.

iron_skin.name: Iron Skin
iron_skin.description: Harden like iron: soak up the next two hearts of damage within 10 seconds.

eldritch_bowstaff.name: Eldritch Bowstaff
eldritch_bowstaff.description: Sweep nearby foes with stacking curses. Cursed deaths dissolve into allied corrupted mini-beasts.

demon_blade.name: Demon Blade
demon_blade.description: Draw blood to frenzy, gaining damage and attack speed while taking double damage.

storm_trident.name: Storm Trident
storm_trident.description: Throw into a targeted storm zone. Pinned foes take double damage during the stun window. Retrieve the trident before throwing again.

valkyrian_sling.name: Valkyrian Sling
valkyrian_sling.description: Loose a returning shot that ricochets through the enemy line and can be parried back stronger.

dragonbone_dagger.name: Dragonbone Dagger
dragonbone_dagger.description: Carve a rapid crossing wound whose stacking armor reduction makes every cut bite deeper.

archon_crossbow.name: Archon Crossbow
archon_crossbow.description: Fire a metal skewer that pierces and drags foes, gaining damage for every creature speared.

divine_hammer.name: Divine Hammer
divine_hammer.description: Call down a radiant smash. Killing a foe refreshes it and repeats on the nearest enemy.

grim_reaver.name: Grim Reaver
grim_reaver.description: Reap a huge critical arc; kills begin a rampage with increasing critical chance.

sentinel_shield.name: Sentinel Shield
sentinel_shield.description: Bash the front line with a stunning impact that drives enemies far backward.

umbral_bow.name: Umbral Bow
umbral_bow.description: Fire a shadow arrow that leashes and slows foes while stealing their speed.

michaels_orb.name: Michael's Orb
michaels_orb.description: A prismatic familiar absorbs basic-attack energy, then releases a seeking elemental bolt that explodes and pinballs through enemies.

gulthias_staff.name: Gulthias Staff
gulthias_staff.description: Fire a wooden bolt. Bolt kills grow foliage; shoot mature foliage with this staff to awaken a temporary treant. Up to 12 plants and 6 treants.

skyblinder_staff.name: Skyblinder Staff
skyblinder_staff.description: Charge a bolt of startling light. Longer charges become heavy radiant explosions with longer stuns.

dragonstaff_of_ahghairon.name: Dragonstaff of Ahghairon
dragonstaff_of_ahghairon.description: Hold Space to breathe flame. Sustained exposure ignites enemies; nearby charred remains refill fuel once. Fuel slowly regenerates while idle. Walls block flame.

jade_serpent_staff.name: Jade Serpent Staff
jade_serpent_staff.description: Fire a slowing venom dart to mark prey. Marked deaths release a serpent that bites each remaining mark once. Serpent damage cannot breed more serpents.

arachne_staff.name: Arachne Staff
arachne_staff.description: Anchor and trail sticky silk. Caught enemies are slowed while each victim grants speed and attack damage; activate again to cut the web.

tome_of_toth.name: Tome of Toth
tome_of_toth.description: For 45 seconds, basic attacks fire spectral script. Nearby deaths add soul capacity; accurate shots build damage within it. A missed shot loses half the current stacks.

shangos_shatterer.name: Shango's Shatterer
shangos_shatterer.description: Trace a vector of small lightning blasts, followed seconds later by a violent sequence of thunderbursts.

solar_scepter.name: Solar Scepter
solar_scepter.description: Radiate burning light, disorient nearby enemies, deepen their fire vulnerability, and answer received damage with a solar flare.

drumamus_bargain.name: Drumamu's Bargain
drumamus_bargain.description: Anchor inside a growing gravity sphere that pulls, twirls, and crushes enemies while the activation is held.

siren_song_lyre.name: Siren Song Lyre
siren_song_lyre.description: Its song turns critically wounded enemies against their allies. Activate for a cacophony that drives the entire battlefield into confusion.

witherbloom_brooche.name: Witherbloom Brooche
witherbloom_brooche.description: Deaths nearby bloom into brilliant flowers that heal you and release a slowing wave. Activate to force a garden of restorative blooms.

white_dragon_mask.name: White Dragon Mask
white_dragon_mask.description: Breathe damaging frost across the battlefield. Frosted enemies burst into cascading, slowing ice shards whenever struck.

black_titan_crown.name: Black Titan Crown
black_titan_crown.description: Nearby enemies are crushed by mounting weight while proximity hardens your defenses. Damage endured is added to your attacks.

dissonant_whisper_jar.name: Dissonant Whisper Jar
dissonant_whisper_jar.description: Trap the dying screams along your path, then release the stored phantasms to hunt and tear through your enemies.

mahoragan_adaption_wheel.name: Mahoragan Adaption Wheel
mahoragan_adaption_wheel.description: Repeated damage from each enemy type becomes less effective. Activate to turn that learned resistance into matching offensive power.

pandoras_paradoxical_compass.name: Pandora's Paradoxical Compass
pandoras_paradoxical_compass.description: Detonate a paradox point whose alternating polarity draws enemies inward or reverses them violently outward, amplifying damage after each reversal.

vibranium_tattoo.name: Vibranium Tattoo
vibranium_tattoo.description: Store distance travelled as momentum. Activate to prime your next attack or spell with its multiplier and a kinetic shockwave.

shadowfell_brand.name: Shadowfell Brand
shadowfell_brand.description: Move untouched to build agility and critical chance. Activate for a speed burst and guaranteed shadow ambush; taking damage breaks it.

blood_ruby_gem.name: Blood Ruby Gem
blood_ruby_gem.description: Missing health increases damage while nearby deaths store blood charges. Activate to shape every charge into a blood minion.

abyssal_sapphire_gem.name: Abyssal Sapphire Gem
abyssal_sapphire_gem.description: Hits and close contact stack crushing pressure that slows and weakens enemies. Activate to rupture every stack—or first crush nearby unmarked foes.

feywild_shawl.name: Feywild Shawl
feywild_shawl.description: Summon a capricious host of wild fey. Charisma improves their number and their inclination to favor you.

bramble_vine_snare.name: Bramble Vine Snare
bramble_vine_snare.description: Aim an arboreal wyrm that seeds stunning snares along its tunnel, doubles damage to caught prey, then erupts at the target point.

heartbreaker_amulet.name: Heartbreaker Amulet
heartbreaker_amulet.description: Your hits bind enemy health together so wounds echo across every marked target. Activate to link nearby foes and empower attacks based on current health.

war_horn_of_valor.name: War Horn of Valor
war_horn_of_valor.description: Nearby creatures become faster and more vulnerable. Activate for a damage surge and life-steal from every enemy struck.
